summary: Own the native Fractal for Mac app, gallery, icons and package in Fractal

replay.detail: The app consumes existing client-v0 reads and writes; no claim replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No daemon or generated-client contract changes. SwiftPM consumes the client package in the same repository revision.

rules.detail: The imported native client preserves its existing attention, availability, presence and speech behavior.

compatibility.detail: The app is Fractal.app with bundle identifier tech.compounding.fractal.mac and executable Fractal. Configuration uses FRACTAL_SOCKET, FRACTAL_PERSON, FRACTAL_URL, optional FRACTAL_SPEECH_SOCKET and FRACTAL_MAC_* review switches. Old ATTENTION_* environment variables are not accepted.

downtime.detail: The coordinated dotfiles installer switches the launch agent and retires the old app only after the replacement is ready.

manual.detail: The new bundle identity requests notification consent once. Installation, signing, launchd and speech-host caller authorization remain owned by dotfiles; preference state starts fresh under the new identity.

recovery.detail: Restore the prior dotfiles package pin and matching installer/caller authorization together to roll back the app identity. No daemon state needs recovery.
